title: Unticking every technician on Technician Utilization hides its chart and table
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • Technicians {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Tech One and ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two) have clocked time at {Location-A} this month, so both are listed in the Technician filter of the Technician Utilization chart.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Click View details on Technician Utilization.
  3. Click the Technician filter button.
  4. Untick every technician.
  5. Close the list and look at where the chart and the table were.
  6. Tick {Technician-A} again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The Technician Utilization chart is hidden: no empty chart box and no empty axes are shown in its place.
  • Step 5: The Technician Utilization table under it is hidden too: no table with no rows is shown.
  • Steps 4 and 5: No message, toast or alert appears.
  • Step 6: The chart comes back with {Technician-A}'s line, and the table comes back listing {Technician-A} only.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9580 (Story 8, Chart Filters); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S8-N1 and S8-R5 (since version 42), S8-N1a and S8-R5a (added in version 44, saved on 13 Oct 2026 (13:37 UTC) by Chris Ward with the note "the table follows the chart filter (Ayesha)"; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-13), and section 7 (reworded in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 to name the table); read 14 Oct 2026. Page change: https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=788430850&selectedPageVersions=43&selectedPageVersions=44. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N1: “If the user deselects every technician on a technician chart, that chart is hidden rather than shown empty.”
  • S8-N1a: “In the same case the table under the chart is hidden too, rather than shown with no rows.”
  • Section 7 (User Feedback Summary): “The dashboard is read-only. It shows no toasts, alerts, or validation messages. The only user-facing feedback is a visual state: when every technician is deselected on a technician chart, that chart and the table under it are hidden until at least one technician is selected again (S8-N1, S8-N1a).”
  • S8-R5: “When the user changes a chart filter, the chart reloads scoped to the selected technicians or advisor.”
  • S8-R5a: “The table under the chart follows the same filter: it lists only the selected technicians, or only the selected advisor. With no advisor chosen it lists every advisor, as the chart does.”
